Each account and its entity get a flat allowance of same-side stake across every

Markets V2e: unpaid claims carry into later cycles (arm 2026-10-12 01:00 UTC)

A cycle's claims above its Markets emission were paid pro rata and the rest dropped while the
high-water mark rose by the whole claim. From the arm each entity carries what it was not paid
(claim = payable + owed; paid = claim x min(1, emission / total claims); owed = claim - paid),
weights are paid / emission, a lock breach claims nothing and keeps its balance. owed at the arm
is seeded by replaying the same arithmetic over the cycles since the V2c carry arm.
